line.comment: * player joins the OCV and betrays the galaxy
* Abort research projects. Clear backlog if any.
* Abort all potential phanon quests that player might still have active
* Add-Ons 2.1: Now passes a reason to display why the quests are aborted.
* Add-Ons 1.13: Update equipment table costs. Also give unlimited salvage insurance since OCV players cannot buy these from Company Stations.
* 2.1 abort generic quests
* Expanded 2.2: OCV players cannot use civilian Taxi or Cargo Hauler jobs.
* Remove existing registrations and Cargo Hauler jobs. Existing cargo is retained as ordinary cargo.
* 2.1 remove all ship blueprints
* 2.1 remove player's ship templates
* 2.1 destroy potentially existing Phanon Colony ship

* Herobetty 5.4: Because the player no longer has access to the black market, clean up the predetermined ship arrays. If the black market was already closed, these arrays have already been deallocated in Mayhem.ActivateYakis.xml.
* Herobetty 5.4: Reset perks irrelevant to Xenon: anything to do with maintenance, insurance, food, diplomacy, and interorbital storage.
* Add-Ons 2.0: Pop-up displaying refunded perks.
* Xenon can now terraform planets for the player
* Joining the OCV incurs massive infamy.
* Add-Ons 2.2: Standardized infamy.

line.text: 'Joined the OCV and betrayed the galaxy.'

line.comment: * release mercs
* Add-Ons 1.9.7: Remove player from coalition, if any.
* update players relations. Add-Ons 2.0.2 - do not append to companies array. It is read-only.
* player's new permanent wars
* at this point Phanon becomes the main antagonist for the player because he is their only invasion target and nobody else will attack them
* updating templates. Phanon now builds their largest ships and bigger fleets.
* if Phanon faction did not exist yet they now gain 6 sectors or (as of Add-Ons 1.2) 6% of the galaxy, whichever is greater. Reusing code from Mayhem.ActivateYakis
* Add-Ons 1.2: Clean up logic. Add more sectors if Phanon does not have enough - prevents exploit where Phanon could have 1 sector and then players joins the OCV to easily wipe out Phanon.
* Add-Ons 1.10.2: Increased percentage from 6% to 8%. No longer reuses code from Mayhem.ActivateYakis: reworked sector takeover as follows.

* 1. Check if Phanon has any sectors and under their upper limit. If they have any, check if they need more. The starting point will be from any of those sectors at least 4 jumps away. If Phanon has no sectors, they pick a starting point the same way as how Yaki pick one.
* 2. Once they've chosen a starting point, they conquer up to 1 adjacent sector (or 2 on medium or larger galaxies). A medium galaxy is defined as 100+ sectors.
* 3. For new clusters, Phanon repeats steps 1-2 until they have enough.
* ===== Phanon Sector Takeover =====
* Initialization
* Yaki are eligible because Phanon is allied with them.
* Medium and larger galaxies allow clusters rather than pairs.
* Initial count. Track locally.
* ** Main loop ***
* 1. Find starting sector.
* No Phanon sectors yet: same start logic as Mayhem.ActivateYakis.
* Existing Phanon sectors: new foothold must be at least 4 jumps away.
* Fallback: relax spacing.
* No valid sector? Stop.
* Conquer starting sector.
* Place a jump beacon.
* Stop if Phanon has enough.
* 2. Conquer adjacent sectors.
* Stop when enough adjacents have been taken.
* Stop if we already have enough sectors.
* Filter out playership's current sector, Renegade sector, incompatible factions, weak factions, and other Phanon sectors.
* Conquer adjacent sector.
* Place a jump beacon.
* Safety: stop if no progress.
* Send message to the player.
* Add-Ons 2.0: 10sec wait caused a transient, so the 10 second delay has been moved to after setting relations to ensure factions don't place claims against Phanon.
* phanon enters a perma-alliance with every main faction (Add-Ons 2.0: fixed with proper unbreakable alliance.)
* Add-Ons 2.0: Moved 10 second wait here. The reputation setter is sensitive!
* Add Phanon ships.
* new quest to unlock all Phanon ship blueprints by destroying their faction

line.text: 'Destroy Phanon to acquire their ship blueprints.'

line.comment: * Add-Ons 1.3: No tutorial version of the message on insane mode.
* Wait 40 seconds.
* Reward player by unlocking all Xenon + OCV ship blueprints
* Add-Ons 1.3: In insane mode, only 1 blueprint from each class will be given (blueprint list determined at the start of the game). TS/TP are excluded.
* Add-Ons 1.4.13: Cleaned up insane mode section. Xenon blueprint script now returns a type.
* Add-Ons 2.1: If player completed the Kha'ak quest, return the blueprints back to the player.
* Should never happen since this script is called in Mayhem.StartingOptions.Callbacks. This is just in case for existing games.
* Add-Ons 2.1.3: OCV Ozias reworked - now an Ozias variant and is thus no longer an OCV ship.
* remove Worker auto-quotas (because they could build non Xenon ship types even after you lost their blueprint)
* also remove Fleet reinforcement-quotas for the same reason
* Spawn a player-controlled Xenon fleet at the portal.
* Add-Ons 1.3: Insane difficulty gives a smaller fleet.
* Merged into Mayhem.EquipShip.
* Add-Ons 1.13: The Z now comes with a Jump Beacon. Just in case, this beacon is given only once.
* Add-Ons 1.13: Convert 75% of all credits to red crystals.

* Step 1: iterate through ALL stations. Set their credit thresholds to 0 (ensures no race conditions with Mayhem.Task.Station.Credits), then accumulate whole red-crystal equivalents and leftover credits.
* Steps 1 and 2 must be done separately to avoid integer overflow.
* Add-Ons 2.0.1: Stop task 1322 (credit transfer) if it's up.
* Convert stored money into reds if there's any cash.
* Zero station money.
* Step 2: Get the player's money and determine the number of crystals. If there is any remainder, add it here.
* Step 3: Apply 75% to grand total.
* Step 4: Spawn as many crystals as possible into the following locations:
* a. All player-controlled huge ships at the portal sector.
* b. Scattered around the portal. Crates shall spawn with no more than 2500 crystals.
* Get the available number of crystals to store.
* If the avaiable amount is greater than the remainder, clamp.
* ** DEBUG **
* $t = 'available crystals to add to ' + $playerCapship + ': ' + $availableCrystals
* write to player logbook $t
* ** END DEBUG **
* Add the crystals to the ship, then subtract from budget.
* Count the number of crates. If there are still crystals left, then drop them all at the OCV portal.
* In case there is extra, e.g. 7600 means it takes 4 crates.
* ======= All done! Now notify the player. If there's any overflowed red crystals, then a variant of this message will display. =======
* Overflowed.
* No overflow, standard message.
